integrity: Proof, explicit formulas and a standalone standard-library finite checker are contained in this complete package. Same-model scientific review only; no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Odd primes and finite depths only; no characteristic-two, arbitrary composite modulus, or intermediate L^r endpoint. The constant in O_p(1) is not optimized. Finite checker is corroborative; historical-priority comparison is bounded.
title: Exact Fourier-algebra norm of the complete square set on odd prime-power cyclic groups
